profile_text.body:
Replit is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that describes itself as a platform for building and deploying software collaboratively using AI, with no local setup required. The company's site presents it as a tool for turning ideas into apps, landing pages, mobile and web projects, and videos within a single environment, and emphasizes built-in services for authentication, database management, hosting, and monitoring. Replit also notes an integration with Lakebase and Databricks Apps, which it describes as combining its capabilities with enterprise data and governance tooling.

Replit's primary AI product is Replit Agent, categorized as a coding and developer tool with an agentic coding approach. The site describes a current iteration called Agent 4, which the company says can accept prompts in any order, intelligently sequence requests, and carry a rough concept through to a functional prototype with minimal user guidance. The held facts flag a note regarding source-code exposure associated with Replit Agent. Replit also has a registered MCP server, described as providing buyer-side outcome verification and provider comparison for agent receipts, listed under the free agent economy lab entry.
